goal: Wire the ForgotPassword full-vault-reset flow to a real ProtocolMap RPC method, so the two-tap confirmation UI's call to resetAllWallets() is a genuine round-trip through the messaging contract instead of firing optimistically with no backing call -- resolves debt declared on GLEAM-WALLET-ONBOARDING-UNLOCK.
outcome: packages/messaging/src/protocol.ts's ProtocolMap gains a method for the destructive full-vault reset, registered against WalletLifecycleHandler.resetAllWallets() in the background dispatcher alongside every other registered handler method. The ForgotPassword UI's existing two-tap confirmation calls this real method and only shows completion once the background response actually resolves -- never before, and never on an assumed/optimistic success.

requirements.statement: The new ProtocolMap method follows the existing request/response envelope shape (typed rejections surfaced through @webext-core/messaging, per core-design.md's error model) -- no bespoke error handling path for this one method.

The background dispatcher registers this method against the existing, already-tested WalletLifecycleHandler.resetAllWallets() -- no new reset logic is written; this task wires the existing tested implementation to a real wire method, it does not reimplement vault reset.

The ForgotPassword UI's onResetComplete callback fires only after the real RPC call resolves successfully -- the current optimistic-fire-before-response behavior is removed, not left alongside the real call.
A failed reset (RPC rejection) surfaces a real, specific error state in the ForgotPassword UI -- never a silent failure that still shows the completion screen.

Triggering the ForgotPassword flow's two-tap confirmation actually clears the vault end-to-end through the real RPC call (exercised by a test that mocks/spies the background dispatcher, not by calling resetAllWallets() directly) and the UI only shows completion after that call resolves.
A test covers the RPC-rejection path: the UI shows a real error state and does not show the completion screen.
pnpm vitest run onboarding unlock wallet-lifecycle passes; pnpm tsc -p packages/messaging --noEmit and pnpm tsc -p packages/core --noEmit pass; pnpm wxt build succeeds.
